Check Your Email!!

We are sending out many internships and job opportunities to YOU through Handshake. There are quite a few Summer Internships for 2027 coming out right now and we don't want you to miss them! 
If you have turned off your notifications in Handshake - we can help you turn them back on. 

ALSO!! Look in your "Other" tab if you have that in Outlook. Handshake emails get funneled there too. 

We will try to label the emails with JOB or INTERNSHIP so you know that it is important.
